subject: science
concept: Understanding how the respiratory and circulatory systems work together to deliver oxygen through the body
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student traces a simple path from lungs to heart to body on a virtual diagram, following oxygen's route
exercise.pictorial: Student labels the path oxygen takes on a simplified circulatory/respiratory diagram
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, how oxygen gets from the air into the rest of the body

misconception_flags: believes the lungs and heart work in isolation rather than as a connected system

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
